name: Sharp
role: Fast Node image processing on libvips; resize, composite, convert with low memory
summary: Node-API library over libvips. Promise-based pipelines resize, crop, rotate, composite, tint and convert between JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF and SVG input, handling ICC profiles and alpha, with Buffer and stream I/O. Prebuilt binaries install via pnpm with no system dependencies. Strength: speed and memory use far ahead of ImageMagick or Jimp on batches.
use_when: Over Jimp or ImageMagick for batch resize and encode inside a Node build
Compositing PNG layers with alpha before encoding in a Node scene
Rasterising SVG to PNG in Node when resvg is not already in use
Producing WebP or AVIF deliverables from frames
avoid_when: Shell-only scripts or inspection: ImageMagick is the validated baseline
Per-pixel custom code: Jimp or Image.js
notes: 2026-10-26: Speed comparison (4x-5x faster than ImageMagick) is the project's own claim, not measured here. Requires Node 20.9 or later per the site.

assessment.rationale: Changelog shows 0.35.5 dated 2026-09-27; npm matches. Apache-2.0 on libvips; clearest Node choice over Jimp for speed and formats.

evidence.result: 640x360, 4 channels, hasAlpha; six pixel probes match expected/; raw-pixel and PNG hashes identical across three runs; libvips 8.18.7
evidence.scope: RGBA layer composite plus SVG raster to PNG with alpha kept; sharp 0.35.5, libvips 8.18.7, Node 22.19.0, macOS arm64. Not other formats, speed, ICC, streams or platforms.
